events.details: Dialup across Sydney suburbs + Canberra ('ACAY Network Computing', Chatswood NSW). Earliest Wayback capture Oct 1996; 1994 founding predates the archive and is unverified.

Brand absorbed into VentraIP. VentraIP control of acay.com.au is confirmed by 3 Dec 2013 (homepage is a VentraIP Australia hosting/parking page); a Wayback gap 2005–2013 means the exact absorption year (possibly ~2012) can't be pinned.
